# dispatch summary

## Config loading
`launcher.py` no longer parses job files itself; `launch()` calls `worker_cfg.load_worker_config` and exposes the
resulting `WorkerConfig` as `LaunchSpec.config`. The loader is the single job-config parser (also used by the metrics
sidecar) and now owns the tier rule: model classes in `HIGH_CLASSES` (`frontier`, `astra`) are forced to the high tier,
and `require_tamper_evidence` is derived from the tier.

## Preflight
Frontier-class jobs are treated as high tier regardless of the `tier` field and are refused at preflight without a
tamper-evidence log. Small-model jobs default to the low tier and need no log.

Tamper evidence for high-tier runs: still enforced — the loader forces frontier/astra jobs to high tier and the preflight tests in `tests/test_preflight.py` (unchanged) pass.
